render_note: The page is a 100 dpi greyscale scan (834 x 1035 pixels over 600 x 745 points); the 100 dpi render is one render pixel per scan pixel. Picks were read from the gridded copy bisht-fig1-100dpi.png and its enlargements, which share pixel coordinates.

north.evidence: Fig. 1 (PDF p. 47, printed p. 33), upper right: a compass rose on a long stem with an arrowhead and the letter 'N' above it; no 'true' or 'magnetic' wording on the figure or in the caption 'Fig.1 Banawali Excavations'.
north.survey_year_evidence: Not stated on the figure; Banawali was excavated by the ASI from 1974 onward and the article appeared in Puratattva 29 (1998-99).

scale.evidence: Scale bar at top centre labelled '50 0 50 meters'; the left 50 m segment from its end tick to the 0 tick was picked because the right 50 tick coincides with a render grid line.
